query_text: Create a slope chart comparing each founded-year cohort’s share of all pipeline companies with its share of the pipeline’s total disclosed funding, using cohorts `pre-2010`, `2010-2014`, `2015-2019`, and `2020+`, with funding converted to `$B` and cohorts sorted by the increase from company share to funding share.
sort_rule: descending by increase from company share to funding share
selection_rule: all companies with numeric Founded year; funding shares use disclosed funding only

plot_config.title: Cohort share of companies vs disclosed funding

reasoning_summary: Assigned companies to the pre-2010, 2010-2014, 2015-2019, and 2020+ cohorts.
Computed each cohort’s share of all pipeline companies.
Summed disclosed funding by cohort and converted those sums to funding shares.
Sorted cohorts by the increase from company share to funding share.
open_issues: Funding-share denominators exclude rows with N/A Total raised.
